items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding system property values.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的${...}占位符，并将其替换为相应的系统属性值。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if there is an unresolvable placeholder
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果存在无法解析的占位符

items.source: A text may contain ${...} placeholders, to be resolved as system properties: for example, ${user.dir}. Default values can be supplied using the ":" separator between key and value.
items.translation: 文本可以包含 `${...}` 占位符，用于解析为系统属性：例如，${user.dir}。可以使用键和值之间的":"分隔符提供默认值。

items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding system property values. Unresolvable placeholders with no default value are ignored and passed through unchanged if the flag is set to true.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 `${...}` 占位符，将其替换为相应的系统属性值。如果标志设置为 `true`，则无法解析且无默认值的占位符将被忽略并原样传递。
属性占位符的转义字符：'\'。
属性占位符的尾随符号："}"。
属性占位符的值分隔符："："。

items.source: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - whether unresolved placeholders are to be ignored
items.translation: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - 是否忽略未解析的占位符

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Dave Syer
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Dave Syer
